document: GroundedReview CEE v1.1 label-leakage & construct-validity audit (offline, zero API)

method.served_bytes_source: evidence_store_cee/bundles/*.txt (frozen; sha matches every executed result row)
method.mechanical_test: parse linked/fresh/complete + symptom booleans + acceptance counts from the RENDERED body and apply the frozen gold_w2.oracle_gold rule that the CEE head states in prose

summary.verdict_word_in_body: section heading "INTEGRITY VERDICTS" only (the adjudicated metadata); no ACCEPT/REJECT verdict follows it
summary.ground_truth_phrase: present ONLY in the item-invariant head sentence "Ground truth about mergeability is never given to you."; absent from every evidence body

construct_validity_verdict.literal_label_leakage: NONE FOUND: no gold token, class name, scenario name, decisive_failure/sufficient_success flag, or imperative answer sentence is rendered into any bundle body; the decision enum never appears as a label in the body.
construct_validity_verdict.decision_rule_executability: HIGH: the prompt head states the complete asymmetric decision rule and the body renders every boolean rule input as pre-adjudicated yes/no, so the gold label is mechanically recoverable on 22/22 bundles by pure rule application. CEE therefore measures faithful EXECUTION OF A STATED POLICY OVER ADJUDICATED EVIDENCE FACTS, not unaided inference from primary logs.
construct_validity_verdict.what_is_and_isnt_tested: Linked/fresh/complete applicability and symptom persistence are GIVEN as verdicts, so CEE does not test deriving them. It tests whether the model (i) applies the asymmetric standard correctly and (ii) refuses/commits at the right point. 4/6 REJECT-gold cells additionally show a concrete failing test id; 2/6 (wrong_patch, stale_persists) support REJECT solely through the derived binary "reproduces after patch: yes" with green acceptance record, so on those 2 the cell does not test reading a primary failure at all.

field_taxonomy.provenance: single constant CLAIM_POSITIVE for all 22; unverified

field_taxonomy.field: TEST ARTIFACT counts (F2P x/y, P2P x/y)
field_taxonomy.provenance: signed record own summary, tier-A acceptance block

field_taxonomy.field: concrete failing acceptance / regression test ids + pre-existing list
field_taxonomy.provenance: signed record; pre-existing failures labelled not-regressions in the same block
HMAC verification of the signed record
offline adjudication over record hashes + attestation

field_taxonomy.field: issue symptom present before / reproduces after (two booleans)
field_taxonomy.provenance: executed pre/post symptom probe; only the binary verdict is rendered, NOT the raw probe log
fixture/gold key only; neutralised out of the record
build/manifest side data only; never rendered

error_intersection_and_difference.rationale_limitation: cee_run_v11 persisted only raw_content_sha256 and the parsed decision; the model reason/missing_evidence strings were NOT stored, so error attribution rests on served inputs + decisions, not on quoted rationale. Re-calling to retrieve rationale is forbidden by the zero-API authorisation.
